description: Community ZipVoice / ZipVoice-Distill flow-matching TTS with a TTSZipformer backbone (U-Net downsampling stacks, compact relative position attention), duration prediction from prompt ratio, Euler solver with t-shift and classifier-free guidance, and Vocos mel-24kHz vocoder (k2-fsa/ZipVoice).

request.name: reference_text
request.description: Transcript matching the reference voice audio; required for zero-shot cloning.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: Classifier-free guidance scale; default 3.0 for ZipVoice-Distill (guidance-scale embedding), 1.0 for ZipVoice (batched CFG). 0 disables guidance.

request.name: num_inference_steps
request.description: Euler ODE steps; default 8 for ZipVoice-Distill, 16 for ZipVoice.

request.name: t_shift
request.description: Shift timesteps toward low SNR (smaller = stronger shift); default 0.5.

request.name: speed
request.description: Speech speed multiplier applied through the prompt-duration ratio; default 1.0.

request.name: feat_scale
request.description: Feature scale applied to log-mel features; default 0.1 (reference default).

request.name: target_rms
request.description: Target RMS for prompt loudness normalization; 0 disables. Default 0.1.

request.name: lang
request.description: espeak language for phonemization; default en-us.

session.name: vocos_path
session.description: Path to the Vocos vocoder checkpoint (vocos.safetensors or GGUF); required unless bundled in the model GGUF or placed next to the checkpoint.

session.name: guidance_scale
session.description: Default guidance scale for requests that do not set it.

session.name: num_inference_steps
session.description: Default Euler steps for requests that do not set it.

session.name: t_shift
session.description: Default timestep shift for requests that do not set it.

session.name: espeak_library_path
session.description: Path to the espeak-ng shared library (e.g. /opt/homebrew/lib/libespeak-ng.dylib) for tokenizer=espeak.

session.name: espeak_data_path
session.description: Path to the espeak-ng data directory or package for tokenizer=espeak.

packages.description: Self-contained GGUF: flow-matching model, bundled Vocos vocoder and the embedded text-frontend sidecars (tokens, config, zh tables) in one file. Converted from k2-fsa/ZipVoice with export_zipvoice_zh_dict.py + convert_zipvoice.py.
Self-contained Q8_0 GGUF with bundled Vocos and embedded text-frontend sidecars.
